echo "===== 部署优化 image_search_multisource.py 287348 $(date '+%F %T') ====="

/root/bot/venv/bin/python -m py_compile /root/bot/bot/plugins/image_search_multisource.py.new && echo "语法OK" || { echo "语法失败,中止不覆盖"; rm -f /root/bot/bot/plugins/image_search_multisource.py.new; exit 1; }

if [ "$NEWMD5" = "37a3901c" ]; then

  echo "已覆盖 image_search_multisource.py"
else
  echo "md5不符,中止不覆盖"
  rm -f /root/bot/bot/plugins/image_search_multisource.py.new
fi
echo "=====完====="
